**Role Purpose**

The Talent Sourcing Specialist will be responsible for building high-quality talent pipelines to support hiring across APAC. This role will proactively identify and engage niche technical and commercial talent across multiple markets, ensuring a steady flow of qualified candidates for critical business roles.

This position plays an important role in strengthening Talent Acquisition outcomes by accelerating time-to-fill, improving candidate quality, and enabling recruiters to focus on stakeholder engagement and hiring decisions.

* Work closely with TA Partners to align sourcing strategy with business priorities.
* Present curated and qualified candidate shortlists to support efficient hiring decisions.
* Ensure consistency and quality in sourcing practices across markets.

**Performance Indicators**

* Quality and conversion of candidate pipelines
* Speed of shortlist delivery for priority roles
* Reduction in aged requisitions
* Candidate engagement and offer acceptance outcomes
* Hiring manager and TA partner satisfaction

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 4–5 years of experience in sourcing or recruiting, preferably within engineering, construction, manufacturing, or field services.

For our business, for clients, and for you

**Jr AppSec Engineer**

**Application security assurance, governance and risk decisions**

**Job Posting Title**

**Jr AppSec Engineer**

**Department**

Information Security - Application Security

  

**Employment Type**

Permanent

  

**Management Level**

Assistant Vice President 3

  

**About Apex**

Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With 50 offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients and family offices.

The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry, including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll, and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies.

We look to recruit bright, articulate and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge. We value people who work hard, care about what they do and are prepared to innovate.

Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today. As we grow, that contribution becomes even more important. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to help you thrive.

  

**About the Role**

This AVP3 position is a senior individual-contributor role focused on consistent, risk-based application security assurance across a large application estate. It covers application discovery and classification, proportionate security reviews, evidence quality, exceptions and a clear view of coverage and residual risk.

Although the posting title is Jr AppSec Engineer, the management level requires mature judgement, credible stakeholder leadership and the ability to quality-review assurance decisions. The role remains technically grounded and must recognise when manual testing or specialist review is required.

  

**Location:** Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role.

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead application and API discovery campaigns with technology, business and governance stakeholders; reconcile inventories, identify ownership gaps and define the population requiring AppSec oversight.

* Apply and improve risk-classification criteria using criticality, data, exposure, users, transactions, technology, regulatory relevance, threat and change to determine assurance depth and cadence.

* Review existing security evidence for control intent, scope, recency, testing method and applicability; reuse credible evidence and identify requirements that still need review or testing.

* Create proportionate assurance plans that combine existing evidence, questionnaires, design review, threat modelling, automated control results and specialist testing based on risk.

* Direct proportionate application security reviews, track completion and quality-review decisions with explicit conditions, assumptions and validity periods.

* Coordinate with AppSec testing, Red Team and DevSecOps colleagues when technical depth is required; ensure their output is incorporated into the assurance decision.

* Collaborate with architecture teams on security requirements and risk challenge without taking ownership of target architecture, solution design or design-authority decisions.

* Support threat-modelling and secure-design discussions, ensuring actions have owners and are reflected in delivery plans and acceptance criteria.

* Govern exceptions and risk acceptance: confirm accountable ownership, rationale, risk statement, compensating controls, remediation plan, expiry and required approval.

* Challenge weak or incomplete evidence and prevent administrative completion from being treated as security effectiveness.

* Maintain clear review records, decision logs and evidence traceability for governance, audit and regulatory review.

* Define metrics for population coverage, risk tiers, assessment status, evidence reuse, gaps, findings, remediation, exceptions and overdue decisions; explain trends and limitations.

* Prepare concise governance reporting and facilitate decisions with application owners, engineering leaders, Information Security, Risk, Compliance and Audit.

Coach junior assurance staff, calibrate decisions across reviewers and improve standards, templates and playbooks using lessons from delivery.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Typically 6+ years in application security assurance, technology risk, product security, security governance or a closely related discipline.

* Demonstrated experience delivering risk-based application security assurance across multiple applications and stakeholder groups.

* Strong judgement in evidence sufficiency, control effectiveness, risk classification, exception quality and review conditions.

* Working knowledge of application architectures, web and API risk, threat modelling, secure development and automated security testing.

* Ability to translate between technical findings, control requirements, business impact and accountable risk decisions.

* Experience producing governance metrics and evidence that can withstand audit or regulatory challenge.

* Confident stakeholder facilitation and escalation, including the ability to challenge senior owners constructively.

* Strong written documentation, attention to traceability and ability to manage a sizeable portfolio.

Fluent English, spoken and written.  

  

**Additional Practical Experience**

* Experience in financial services or another regulated global organisation.

* Familiarity with control frameworks and secure development standards such as NIST SSDF, OWASP SAMM, ASVS, ISO 27001 or similar.

* Experience with GRC platforms, application inventories, work-management tools or evidence automation.

* Evidence of practical capability improving application security assurance or secure development practices.

Experience improving an assurance operating model or rationalising duplicate controls.  

  

**Candidate Expectations**

* Be rigorous about evidence while making assurance proportionate to actual risk.

* Do not confuse process completion with an effective security outcome.

* State assumptions, gaps, conditions and decision ownership clearly; avoid ambiguous conclusions.

* Use metrics to support decisions and improvement, not to create false precision.

* Build trusted relationships and lead governance activity from the Hyderabad office.

**EY Technology:**

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

  

**The opportunity**

As part of the Identity and Access Management organization, this individual will support and manage all end-to-end aspects of the Active Directory and Cloud services. The individual will implement, automate and support secure directory services across Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity environments.

  

This will include building infrastructure, deploying servers and configuration changes to the environment. The Engineer provides support, implementation, and design services for Microsoft Active Directory and Azure Active Directory across the enterprise, including directory and identity management solutions. Resolves and appropriately completes assigned cases and change requests and acts as an escalation for support issues. Other responsibilities include driving stability and security and remediation of potential security vulnerabilities. This individual will work closely with other teams within EY to drive technology standards and consistency across IT Services.

  

The role combines traditional directory engineering skills with delivery of security-hardening and modernization initiatives, including Tier 0 controls, delegated access, service account and non-human identity management, group managed service accounts, domain controller and operating system upgrades, Entra role governance, recovery capabilities and directory automation.

The engineer will work with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Security and application teams to deliver resilient, least-privileged and supportable directory capabilities.

* Ability to communicate solutions, ideas, suggestions to a variety of (business) stakeholders effectively and comprehensively.

* Demonstrates analytical and systematic approach to problem solving.

* Support Tier 0 security, administrative tiering, privileged access workstations and secure management paths.
* Implement or enhance controls such as LAPS, protected accounts, authentication policies, cipher hardening and privileged role reduction.
* Experience with Windows Server 2022 upgrades, security baselines, LAPS, WDAC or Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Support security assessments, attack-path remediation, vulnerability remediation and audit evidence collection.
* Work with security tools such as Microsoft Defender for Identity, Silverfort or comparable identity threat protection platforms.

* Support ownership, attestation, necessity validation, naming, description and standards compliance for directory objects.
* Administer and engineer Active Directory forests, domains, organizational units, sites, trusts, replication, DNS and Group Policy.
* Maintain Active Directory forest recovery and cyber recovery capabilities, ensuring alignment with business continuity and security requirements.
* Configure and support Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity components, including Microsoft Entra Connect.
* Maintain automation solutions using PowerShell to reduce manual administration, improve consistency and support directory modernization initiatives.
* Troubleshoot authentication, replication, synchronization, directory object and policy issues.
* Implement secure standards for users, groups, computers, service accounts and privileged identities.
* Support directory integrations using LDAP, Kerberos, NTLM, DNS and related protocols.

* Fluent in English language - written and verbal
* Knowledge and understanding of Information Security, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Active Directory Domain Services and Microsoft Entra ID
* Experience in deploying or migrating IAM solutions, including Active Directory, Azure Active Directory etc. within production environments.
* Hands-on experience with Group Policy, DNS, LDAP, Kerberos, trusts, replication and privileged group management.
* Should be familiar with AD Migration / Upgrade methods, AD Performance, Scalability, availability, and DR concepts.
* Understanding of Tier 0, least privilege, privileged access, service accounts, gMSAs and non-human identity security.
* Experience using PowerShell for directory administration, automation and reporting.
* Should be able to participate in L4 escalations in SME capability and should be able to provide sound reasoning and conduct RCA during problem investigation meetings.
* Extensive experience in large scale Azure cloud-based application solutions and integration with other Cloud or On-premises products and custom solutions
* Knowledge of Windows Server administration, security baselines, patching and controlled infrastructure change.
* Knowledge of one or more automation and scripting languages such as PowerShell, Visual Basic, Power Automate etc.
* Familiarity with Active Directory security hardening concepts, including tiered security, privileged access workstations (PAWs), administrative forests, and just-in-time access
* Experience in one or more of these areas is desirable
  + SCCM, SCOM, RMAD, Splunk, ARS, Shielded VM / Hyper-V, ADLDS, IPSec

description:
YOUR TEAM

Our Sustainable Water Management team works across a spectrum of services covering water quality and catchment management water resources and security, hydrology and hydraulics, geomorphology, hydroecology and hydrogeology. We provide high quality technical services and advice to high-profile customers in the UK and overseas, including government departments and agencies, the water industry, and industrial sectors, including power, transport, nuclear, mining, commercial and oil and gas.

We offer a dynamic, but supportive environment for a motivated and talented individual to fulfil their potential. We recognise that our people are central to our success as a business. As a consequence, we are committed to a providing a comprehensive framework for the professional development of our staff, including:

* Access to extensive internal and external training opportunities;
* A mentoring programme; and
* Support for gaining chartership through professional institutions.

  

YOUR NEW ROLE, WHAT’S INVOLVED?

We are seeking professionals with more than 2+yrs of industry experience to join our rapidly expanding team of Water Quality and Catchment Management specialists so that we can continue to deliver sustainable solutions to the water sector and environmental regulators in the UK and help protect the water environment.

With a background in earth sciences and working knowledge of water quality and geochemistry / environmental chemistry you should be aware of the UK situation with regard to:

* How river, lake and TraCs water quality is protected through the WFD and other regulatory tools;
* Be aware / have working knowledge of water quality modelling tools (SAGIS, SIMCAT, InfoWorks ICM UPM etc.).
* Experience on national level infrastructure projects, particularly for National Highways. Experience of HEWRAT or drainage would be advantageous.
* Experience of EIA scoping, reviews and assessments for water/hydrology chapters.
* Experience of water quality permitting and completion or review of H1 and RQP assessments.
* Demonstrate understanding of how to conceptualise a water quality problem and knowledge of the available datasets which can be used in problem solving.

Prior work experience, either postdoctoral or in consultancy or working in the water sector (regulator or industry) would be desirable.

You should have an interest in problem solving through interrogation of time series and spatial datasets, good conceptualisation skills and understand the important of source pathway receptor models and be able to clearly communicate ideas either through your writing or visualisations. An awareness of how groundwater and surface water interact would also be useful.

Awareness of sampling network design, liaising with UK teams on risk assessment before field work, and data collation and interpretation (for river and / or groundwater sampling and monitoring) would also be beneficial and some knowledge of catchment management / agri-environment schemes.

The role will include the following:

* Water quality data analysis, conceptualisation and visualisation and clear communication;
* Carrying out desk-based investigations / interpretation of datasets.
* Helping to design field monitoring campaigns including traditional and non-traditional approaches;
* Delivery of technical reports and presentations to clients; and
* Winning new work and writing proposals for new projects.
* Project and task management.
* Being a key member of our water quality team in Sustainable Water Management;

You will be based in our India office (Bengaluru or Mumbai as per your choice), but will work collaboratively with teams across WSP’s global business and mainly with our UK based teams. So, being able to work effectively as part of a diverse team, as well as individually for discrete tasks, is very important to us.

  

WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE

* Degree-level qualifications in a relevant subject (e.g. geography, geology, geochemistry, earth/environmental science, civil engineering or similar);
* A higher degree in a relevant discipline (e.g. river or lake water quality, water chemistry, hydrogeochemistry, water management, environmental science, or similar), is desirable, but not essential;
* You should have excellent analytical skills, and be able to apply them to analysing problems and finding solutions to novel challenges;
* Experience in use of MS Office tools (Word, Teams, Excel, Access, Powerpoint) and use of GIS packages, such as ArcGIS or QGIS;
* You will collaborate effectively as part of a team and be able to work independently with some steer;
* You will demonstrate excellent communication skills, being able to write clearly and / or communicate ideas through visualisations.

description:
**Job Description – Sr. Executive / Manager – Accounts**

**Experience:** 3–6 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Job Location:** Delhi (On-site)  
**CTC:** Up to ₹6 LPA

**About ASTAR**

Since 2017, ASTAR has been manufacturing electric scooters, EV batteries, chargers and e-rickshaws across India. With over 9 years of EV industry expertise, 7 manufacturing facilities and a network of 2,000+ authorized dealers across 800+ cities, ASTAR is committed to delivering reliable and innovative electric mobility solutions.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Accounts professional to manage day-to-day accounting operations, financial transactions, taxation compliance and reporting. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Tally ERP, GST, TDS, Accounts Payable/Receivable and Advanced Excel.

Candidates with experience in D2C, EV manufacturing, production, automobile or other manufacturing industries will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including voucher entries, journal entries, ledger maintenance and bank reconciliations.
* Handle Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR), including vendor payments, customer collections and outstanding tracking.
* Manage GST-related activities, including GST data preparation, reconciliation, return coordination and compliance.
* Handle TDS calculations, deductions, reconciliations, return preparation and timely compliance.
* Maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper documentation of all transactions.
* Manage vendor invoices, purchase bills, expense entries and payment processing.
* Perform bank, vendor and customer ledger reconciliations.
* Prepare monthly financial reports, MIS reports, ageing reports and expense statements.
* Assist in monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing activities.
* Coordinate with internal departments, vendors, customers, auditors and consultants for accounting-related matters.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations and statutory requirements.
* Maintain and update accounting records using Tally ERP.
* Prepare data analysis, financial summaries and reports using Advanced Excel.

**Required Skills & Expertise**

* Strong working knowledge of Tally ERP / Tally Prime.
* Hands-on experience in GST, including reconciliation and return-related activities.
* Good understanding of TDS provisions, calculations and compliance.
* Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
* Proficiency in Advanced Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF/SUMIFS, IF formulas and data analysis.
* Knowledge of bank reconciliation, ledger scrutiny and financial reporting.
* Understanding of accounting principles, taxation and statutory compliance.
* Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving abilities.
* Good coordination, communication and documentation skills.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

Candidates with prior experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:

* D2C / E-commerce
* Electric Vehicle (EV) Manufacturing
* Automobile Manufacturing
* Production / Manufacturing Units
* Consumer Durables or Trading Companies

Exposure to inventory accounting, purchase accounting, stock reconciliation and manufacturing-related financial operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) or a related field.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Practical working experience in Tally ERP, GST, TDS and Advanced Excel.
* Candidates with experience in manufacturing or production-based organisations will be preferred.

**Compensation**

**CTC: Up to ₹6,00,000 per annum**, depending on relevant experience, skills and suitability for the role.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their updated CV through the following channels:

**Email:** rohitkumar@outlook.in  
**WhatsApp:** +91 8178213368

Please mention **"Sr. Executive / Manager – Accounts – ASTAR"** while submitting your application.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next stage of the recruitment process.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

* Ability to deliver energy-saving initiatives and ESG-related environmental metrics, including electricity, water, waste and emissions inputs.
* Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with AutoCAD, digital FM tools and maintenance reporting systems is desirable.

Educational Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Management or a related technical discipline. Candidates with a relevant diploma and substantial experience in large-scale technical facility operations and projects may be considered. **Role & responsibilities**

To support the effective implementation of HR policies, procedures, and processes at the Corporate Office by managing day-to-day HR operations, recruitment, employee records, payroll inputs, statutory compliance, employee engagement, and HRMS activities, while ensuring adherence to company policies and applicable labour laws.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment and Manpower Planning**

* Coordinate recruitment activities, including job postings, candidate sourcing, resume screening, interview scheduling, and candidate communication.
* Liaise with departmental heads and recruitment consultants to fulfil approved manpower requirements.
* Coordinate interview feedback, salary approvals, offer releases, and pre-employment documentation.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and recruitment status reports.
* Support employee referral programmes and other talent acquisition initiatives.

**HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Manage day-to-day HR operations and provide support to employees and departmental heads on HR-related matters.
* Coordinate employee onboarding, joining formalities, documentation, induction, and orientation.
* Maintain and update employee personal files, service records, employee databases, and other HR documentation.
* Handle employee confirmation, transfers, promotions, changes in designation, and other employee lifecycle activities.
* Coordinate employee separation formalities, including resignation documentation, exit interviews, clearance, and full and final settlement inputs.
* Issue and coordinate employment-related letters, certificates, and other HR communications as required.

**Attendance, Leave and HRMS Administration**

* Administer employee attendance, leave records, short-leave applications, regularization requests, and attendance-related discrepancies through HRIMS
* Monitor attendance records and coordinate with employees and reporting managers to resolve exceptions.
* Maintain employee information, organizational records, and HR documents in HRIMS
* Support employees and managers in using HRMS modules for attendance, leave, expense claims, and other HR processes.
* Ensure timely submission and verification of attendance and payroll inputs

**Statutory Compliance and Documentation**

* Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements, including Provident Fund, ESIC, Professional Tax, gratuity, bonus, and other applicable provisions.
* Coordinate with statutory consultants and relevant internal departments for timely filing of returns, payment of contributions, and maintenance of statutory records.
* Maintain employee documentation and records required for statutory audits, inspections, and compliance reviews.
* Assist in the preparation and verification of statutory challans, returns, registers, and compliance reports, as applicable.
* Track statutory updates and support the implementation of changes in HR policies and procedures in coordination with the Manager HR.

**Employee Engagement and HR Initiatives**

* Coordinate employee engagement activities, celebrations, employee welfare initiatives, and internal communication.
* Support employee recognition programmes, rewards and felicitation initiatives, and employee experience activities.
* Assist in organizing training programmes, employee development initiatives, and other HR interventions.
* Coordinate employee feedback, HR announcements, and communication of company policies and guidelines.
* Support the administration of employee benefits, group Mediclaim and other employee welfare schemes.

**Performance Management and HR Reporting**

* Coordinate the Performance Management System (PMS), including communication of timelines, distribution of forms, follow-ups, and consolidation of performance review inputs.
* Maintain PMS records and assist in compiling performance appraisal and increment-related data.
* Prepare periodic HR reports covering headcount, recruitment, attrition, attendance, leave, payroll inputs, and other HR metrics.
* Assist in HR budgeting by compiling data relating to recruitment, employee benefits, training, employee engagement, and other HR expenses.
* Support the preparation and maintenance of HR dashboards, trackers, and management reports.

**Policy Administration and Employee Relations**

* Assist in the implementation and communication of HR policies, procedures, employee handbook provisions, and company guidelines.
* Respond to routine employee queries and escalate sensitive or complex matters to the Manager HR.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and other employee relations issues.
* Support the administration of POSH-related processes and other workplace compliance initiatives, maintaining strict confidentiality.
* Ensure proper documentation and controlled access to confidential employee information.

**Coordination with Manufacturing Unit**

* Coordinate with the Plant HR and administration team for employee-related information, HR reports, policy implementation and other common HR activities.

**Educational Qualification**

* Graduate/ MBA/PGDM in HRM; a qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration, or Personnel Management will be preferred.

**Experience**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in HR operations and generalist HR activities.
* Experience in a manufacturing or corporate office environment will be preferred.
* Working knowledge of HRMS, payroll coordination, recruitment, and statutory compliance is desirable.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund
